links.comparator_used: Standard prompt without the forewarning (control group, no debiasing instruction)
links.outcome: Overall cognitive bias in GPT responses across 10 clinically nuanced cases; length of response; frequency of discussing cognitive biases
links.effect: Forewarning decreased overall bias by only 6.9%; no bias was extinguished completely; responses were 50% longer and discussed cognitive biases more than 100 times more frequently
links.tradeoff: Responses were 50% longer; responses appeared thoughtful and deliberate despite persistent bias, which risks false reassurance
links.quote: Despite these differences, the forewarning decreased overall bias by only 6.9%, and no bias was extinguished completely.
